spanish: Y dijo Moisés: No *es* firme hacer así, porque la abominación de Egipto sacrificaremos a Jehová nuestro Dios. He aquí, sacrificaremos la abominación de Egipto a sus ojos, y no nos apedrearán.
grammarChanges: Marked the supplied copula with italics: *es*, since נָכוֹן is a niphal participle with no finite copula token.
Removed the question marks from the final clause (וְלֹא plus imperfect, no interrogative particle); it now stands as a plain negative statement, 'y no nos apedrearán.'
Made both occurrences of the repeated qal imperfect 1cp (h02008026010, h02008026014) agree in tense, both future 'sacrificaremos', instead of present-then-future.
Made both construct-chain nouns (h02008026008, h02008026016) agree in definiteness, both 'la abominación de Egipto', since the proper-name governor makes the construct noun definite.
readerNote: Chose future tense for both occurrences of the repeated qal imperfect verb and definite form for both 'abominación de Egipto' construct nouns to resolve agreement the morphology left open; *es* marks a supplied copula.
